description: Assemble an open stage, check part_count and the sha256 of the exact assembled text (the concatenation of the parts in order, before this server redacts it), then write one revision through write_doc. A mismatch or a write_doc refusal leaves the current document unchanged and the stage open. A second commit of the same sha256 returns the first receipt and does not write another revision. A record is still one whole revision: it is superseded, never patched or appended.

doc_id.description: The same document id the stage was begun for.

exchange.description: The exchange (turn) this write belongs to, counting from 1. A write for exchange n while exchange n-1 was never appended is refused by the session graph until n-1 is appended.

part_count.description: How many parts were appended. Commit is refused if the stage holds a different number.

reason.description: Optional. When omitted, the reason stored at begin is used. A different reason is refused.

session_id.description: Your transcript session id from emet_session_open. The session graph reads this session's state before the write and returns `session_graph.next` - the next step. A governed write with no session is refused (open one with emet_session_open and load_id).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the exact assembled text.

source.description: Source tag. Must match the stage.

supersedes.description: Optional. When omitted, the value stored at begin is used. A different number is refused.

name: write_doc_commit
